divergences.topic: Is mid-grammar masking of stop_token_ids the defect, or is the defect the post-termination accept path?
divergences.lane_a_position: worker-a (opus, high conf): the mid-grammar masking is CORRECT. The real defect is post-termination: once the JSON grammar terminates, _fill_bitmasks writes a FULL unconstrained mask (__init__.py:198-205); the model samples special token 200028 (<|begin_of_text|> BOS, not EOS 200006, not a stop id); scheduler.py:1844 calls grammar.accept_tokens([200028]) with NO is_terminated guard (unlike the sibling paths at __init__.py:199 and :324); XgrammarGrammar.accept_tokens short-circuits `if self._is_terminated: return False` (backend_xgrammar.py:158-159) whereas GuidanceGrammar returns True/no-op (backend_guidance.py:169-170); scheduler maps False->RequestStatus.FINISHED_ERROR->HTTP 500. Fix: add is_terminated guard on the scheduler accept path and/or make xgrammar accept_tokens no-op (return True) when terminated.
divergences.lane_b_position: worker-b (sonnet, medium conf): the masking IS the bug and is a regression from PR #49227 (merged 05f0a80016). _create_grammar forwards sampling_params.all_stop_token_ids verbatim as override_stop_tokens; xgrammar REPLACES the grammar's terminators with that set and unconditionally excludes every listed id from ordinary content matching until an accepting state, so any user stop_token_ids value colliding with content the schema requires becomes unavailable mid-grammar (garbage substitution or all-masked bitmask row). Fix: forward only true EOS-class ids (eos_token_id + generation_config eos) into override_stop_tokens; keep caller stop_token_ids out of the grammar-compile path.
divergences.why_it_matters: The two point at different defects in different files with mutually exclusive fixes ('masking is correct' vs 'masking is the bug'). Picking either fix alone leaves the other diagnosis's failure entirely unaddressed. Only worker-a's diagnosis is grounded in the actual reported symptom (HTTP 500, token 200028, the 'grammar rejected tokens [200028]' log line, the Inkling-Small model); worker-b describes a plausible but unverified latent issue whose failure surface it could_not_verify and which does not clearly produce the reported 500.
